messages:
devon: Hey team — planning a phased return after parental leave. Looking to come back 2026-06-15 at 60% for 3 weeks, then 80% for 2 weeks before full time. Also need to travel to EU for kid's school enrollment for ~10 days during that phased window. What paperwork do I need and will benefits/payroll be affected?

anya (People Ops): Congrats! :) Quick checklist below — will help us route to payroll/benefits. Please submit the phased-return form in the HR portal and add the travel dates.

devon: Where's the phased-return form? Not obvious in portal.

anya (People Ops): Top nav -> "Leaves & Return" -> "Phased Return / Reduced Schedule". If you want, copy this msg to your manager:

```
Hi @sarah — request: phased return from parental leave. Start 2026-06-15: 3 weeks at 60% (Mon/Wed full days, Tue/Thu half-day), then 2 weeks at 80% (4 days). I'll be traveling to Amsterdam 2026-06-20 -> 2026-06-30 for school enrollment; plan to work remotely those dates within reduced hours. Need your approval for schedule and coverage plan.
```

sarah: Thanks for the heads-up @devon — looks fine in principle. We should map on-call/handoff for the 2 weeks. Can you put proposed blockers in the calendar and I’ll approve the request once People Ops confirms payroll impact?

payroll-bot: FYI — phased returns use payroll code: PARENT_PHASE. Auto-adjusts vacation accrual. For US employees: benefit premiums remain as-is for up to 12 weeks of approved phased return. International travel while on reduced schedule may trigger tax/residency checks if >30 days in a rolling 12-mo window.

devon: I will be <10 days abroad during phased window (not >30). Good. Any travel pre-approval needed?

anya (People Ops): Yes — remote work from another country needs manager approval + People Ops sign-off for privacy/data access and security posture. Please fill the "Remote Work Abroad" mini-form (same Leaves page) with destination and location details. We'll loop in Security if necessary.

amir (Finance): Quick note on stipend/backup care: you may be eligible for the Family Support Stipend for up to $900 total during a phased return if you can show receipts for childcare/schooling costs tied to ramp. People Ops verifies eligibility. Also, if you reduce hours, your bonus payout pro-rates per Redwood policy (see compensation guide).

devon: Is the stipend automatic? What's the cutoff to qualify?

anya (People Ops): Not automatic — submit receipts within 30 days after phased period ends. Eligibility: full-time headcount at leave start, approved phased-return filed, and no outstanding performance-type corrective actions. We'll confirm when you submit the phased form.

payroll-bot: Action items for @devon: 1) Submit phased-return form with detailed schedule, 2) Submit Remote Work Abroad mini-form for Amsterdam dates, 3) Attach travel itinerary and childcare invoice placeholders if you want stipend pre-approval (not required but speeds review).

sarah: Once forms are in, I’ll coordinate coverage plan and approve in the portal. @anya can you confirm whether PTO accrual or holiday pay changes during the 60/80% windows?

anya (People Ops): PTO accrual is prorated to scheduled FTE for each pay period during phased return. Holiday pay follows the Redwood holiday policy: if a holiday falls on a day you’re scheduled to work, you'll get prorated holiday pay based on that day of week schedule.

devon: Great. Timeline: I'll submit the forms today. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

anya (People Ops): Perfect — tag me after submission and I’ll fast-track review. If Security needs to weigh in on remote access for EU, we’ll ping here. (reaction :eyes:)
